messages.author: 474f198ce631ba9d
messages.subject: Starting values
parts:
Dear all,
I was wondering if anyone knows how the starting values of the parameters are guessed by lavaan?
Thank you in advance!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Starting values
parts:
On 7/11/20 2:29 PM, Vera wrote:
> Dear all,
> I was wondering if anyone knows how the starting values of the
> parameters are guessed by lavaan?

- for factor loadings, lavaan using 'fabin3' estimates (see Hagglund,
1982); they are computed separately per factor

- for residuals variances of observed variances, lavaan uses the total
variance divided by two

- latent variances are set to 0.05

- everything else is zero

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Starting values
parts:
Only to generate starting values. You can see them (afterwards) in the
lambda matrix of

lavInspect(fit, "start")

Yves.
